scope: PlanformDB 2.5.0-derived bioelectric experiment series S1-S9 for fitting and testing the pole-identity link of 2021-Cervera-Levin-Mafe.py (infinitemorphospace calibration, not rusty-matter runtime dynamics).
notice_text:
Planform / PlanformDB Notice

Source: Lobo Lab PlanformDB 2.5.0
Source page: https://lobolab.umbc.edu/planform/download/

This infinitemorphospace fixture is a small transformed subset of PlanformDB metadata (experiment, result-set and morphology identifiers, sample counts, observation periods, drug exposure windows and outcome frequencies). It does not redistribute the raw SQLite database, region geometry, organ tables, paper figures, or morphology images.

citations.label: Oviedo et al. 2010 - long-range neural and gap-junction cues
Nogi & Levin 2005 - innexin expression and gap-junctional communication in planarian regeneration
Beane et al. 2011 - H,K-ATPase-mediated membrane voltage and planarian head regeneration
Nogi et al. 2009 - praziquantel, voltage-operated Ca2+ channel beta subunits and regenerative polarity

selection_policy.selection_basis: Every PlanformDB 2.5.0 experiment series from Oviedo 2010, Nogi & Levin 2005, Beane 2011 and Nogi 2009 that perturbs planarian AP polarity through gap-junction coupling, membrane voltage or neural cues and reports outcome frequencies against a crop-position, timing or dose axis.
selection_policy.fit_policy: Link parameters may be fitted on S1 only; S2, S3, S6 test gap-junction transfer, S7-S8 the hyperpolarization pole, S4 and S9 calibrate the time scale, S5 tests it. Rows carrying conflicting_control_semantics or placeholder_sample_count are excluded from fits by default.

mechanism_class.gap_junction_block_pharmacological: Alcohol gap-junction blockers (octanol, heptanol, hexanol); coupling reduction label only, no conductance constants.
mechanism_class.gap_junction_rnai: Innexin RNAi (Dj-inx-12 + Dj-inx-5/13); genetic coupling reduction kept distinct from pharmacological block.
mechanism_class.hyperpolarization_hk_atpase: SCH-28080 H,K-ATPase inhibition; anterior hyperpolarization label (Beane 2011).
mechanism_class.depolarization_vgcc: Praziquantel acting through voltage-operated Ca2+ channel beta subunits; depolarization label (Nogi 2009).
mechanism_class.depolarization_glucl_ivermectin: Ivermectin-gated glutamate/chloride channel opening; depolarization label distinct from the VGCC route (Beane 2011).
mechanism_class.neural_vnc_disruption: Ventral nerve cord disruption on top of octanol; neural-cue label kept separate from generic coupling reduction (Oviedo 2010).
mechanism_class.untreated_control: Amputation without drug or RNAi; baseline for the series' publication.

row_flags.placeholder_sample_count: ResultSet.Num is 0 or 1 in the database; treat as a placeholder, no sampling interval can be derived.
row_flags.regen_period_zero: ResultSet.RegenPeriod is 0 in the database; the observation time is not recorded and must come from the paper.
row_flags.conflicting_control_semantics: Row conflicts with another row of the same manipulation and drug; its control/treated semantics must be confirmed against the source figure before use.
row_flags.drug_window_unspecified: ExperimentDrug StartTime = EndTime = 0; the exposure window is not recorded in the database.
row_flags.drug_window_end_unspecified: ExperimentDrug StartTime > 0 with EndTime = 0; the onset is recorded but the end of exposure is not (PlanformDB convention for open-ended exposure).
row_flags.drug_window_inconsistent_within_series: Stored start/end days are the transpose of a sibling row in the same figure panel; the window must be read from the paper's methods before use.
row_flags.drug_window_pre_amputation: ExperimentDrug StartTime < 0; exposure began before amputation.
row_flags.multi_drug_cotreatment: More than one ExperimentDrug row; perturbation labels and drug_exposures list every agent, mechanism_class follows the single mechanism-bearing agent.
row_flags.zero_frequency_outcome_row: At least one ResultantMorphology row is stored with Frequency = 0 (an explicitly recorded absence).
row_flags.control_record: Untreated or uncut control; off the series axis, kept for baseline comparison.
row_flags.supplementary_record: Same publication as the series but not part of the figure panel that defines the series axis.

161.planformdb_name: Head plus post-pharyngeal crop, VNC disruption

excluded_experiments.reason: Oviedo 2010 Fig. 1C lateral notch, CNS and centre-removal geometries under octanol; not an AP crop-position or timing series.

series.label: Octanol x AP crop position
notes: Octanol gap-junction blockade; the only series WP4 fits the link function on.
Shared with the vendored rusty-matter v0 fixture (records 415-419).

series.label: Triple innexin RNAi x AP crop position
notes: Dj-inx-12 + Dj-inx-5/13 RNAi; genetic coupling reduction tested as transfer, not pooled with octanol.
Experiment 445 is the uncut RNAi animal (Fig. 3B, #112) and is kept as a control record off the axis.
Shared with the vendored rusty-matter v0 fixture (records 446-450).

series.label: Heptanol x AP crop position
notes: Heptanol pulse; posterior identity shift is the composite of #2, #74 and #101 frequencies.
Experiments 322 (heptanol), 323 (untreated) and 324 (hexanol) are the Fig. 10III pharyngeal-crop comparison and are supplementary.
Rows 322 and 324-328 store the drug window as start 2.0 / end 0.0 days while 329 stores 0.0 / 2.0; flagged drug_window_inconsistent_within_series, not corrected.

series.label: Octanol onset delay window
notes: Post-pharyngeal crop; octanol added at 0, 3, 6, 12, 24, 48 or 72 h post-amputation.
Experiment 434 (0 h) is stored at 0 % double head, conflicting with experiment 418 (same crop and drug, 100 %); flagged conflicting_control_semantics and excluded from fits by default.
RegenPeriod is 0 for every row; the 14-day observation comes from the paper, not the database.

series.label: VNC disruption timing under octanol
notes: Head plus post-pharyngeal crop with VNC cut at 0, 3, 12 or 24 h; neural cue class kept separate from coupling reduction.
Shared with the vendored rusty-matter v0 fixture (records 441-444).

series.label: Head-retained fragments under octanol
notes: Fragments keep their own head; the axis is the posterior cut position (head only, +pre-pharyngeal, +pharyngeal, +post-pharyngeal).
Tests whether an existing anterior head suppresses the posterior ectopic head under the same blocker.

series.label: SCH-28080 x AP crop position
notes: H,K-ATPase inhibition (hyperpolarization) for 3 days; anterior loss outcomes #20 headless and #21 cyclops.
Rows 391 and 392 store #20 and #21 at Frequency 0 explicitly.

series.label: Bidirectional voltage perturbation, pharynx fragment
notes: Pharynx fragment with slanted anterior: ivermectin (depolarize) vs SCH-28080 (hyperpolarize) vs ivermectin + chloride.
Mechanism classes differ per record (depolarization_glucl_ivermectin vs hyperpolarization_hk_atpase); no series-level class.
Drug windows are stored as 0/0 (unspecified).

series.label: Praziquantel dose and exposure window
notes: Trunk crop; 516-522 are the dose series (1-110 uM, 0-2 d), 523-536 the exposure-window series.
ResultSet.Num is 0 or 1 for every row except 520 (285); no sampling interval is available for this series.
The dose used in the window series is not recorded in the database.
